expectation_provenance_labels.extracted execution (x86_64 slice, glibc: the original program's x86_64 build read the case's text and, where a saved text is judged, wrote the value read, on a Linux x86_64 host with glibc in place of the macOS system libraries; locating, opening and saving remain static-derived

stated_assumptions: The macOS arm64 build converts these texts and values as the x86_64 build does. All cases with the extracted-execution label depend on it.

The reference's binary64 base-10 logarithm errs by less than 3/4 of a binary64 gap wherever its last bit decides k in REQ-011, outside the half-gap band. TS-024 to TS-027, whose logarithms lie 0.02 to 0.17 gaps from an integer, need only an error below 0.8 of a gap.

The reference's decimal reading follows the C-standard number grammar in a locale whose decimal separator is '.', and gives the nearest binary64 value with the sign of -0 kept, as the glibc run did. TS-024 to TS-028, TS-034 and TS-035 depend on it.

The reference's fixed-point text on save is exact, rounds exact decimal ties to even and keeps the sign of negative zero, as the glibc run did; transport-state-v1 accepted exactness and ties to even as inferences. TS-024 to TS-028 depend on it; no case lies on a tie.
